title: Storytelling Through the Lens: Valerie’s Unique Approach to Photography
text:
I first met Valerie in 2012 at an event we were both photographing. I remember her as being exceptionally professional and kind, even as we shared the same space while working for different clients. Valerie made such a strong impression on me that I later hired her to work events with me.

Her work is creative, and she has a remarkable ability to tell stories through her images. Valerie knows exactly how to connect with her subjects, capturing genuine expressions and the essence of each moment.

I highly recommend Valerie for your shoot in Barcelona?

title: Amazing private tour!
text: We only had 3 days in Barcelona and wanted to do something private/not part of a big crowd for our last tour. We booked this one with Valerie on the advice of a friend, and it was perfect! We had so much fun being introduced to the Gothic Quarter. Valerie was knowledgeable,  funny and very accommodating to our little group.  It felt like a personalized tour, and that was exactly what I was looking for.  Highly recommend!! And get the waffle ! 😁

title: The BEST of the Best Tours/Photos
text: First of all, VALERIE IS AMAZING! I had a solo tour with her throughout the Gothic Quarters/ Old Town, El Raval, El Born, and so many more areas of Barcelona. Since I booked the solo tour, Valerie showed me all the places to shop for myself and my friends and family at home, restaurants, and even the locations for the BEST coffee shops. She is funny, knowledgeable, and talented. I have forever memories from Barcelona thanks to this tour! Thank you Valerie for such an unforgettable experience! Highly recommended tour with brilliant photo shots all over Barcelona.
